show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Joost van Dreunen – Unlocking Value in Gaming – [Invest Like the Best, EP.210]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Joost van Dreunen, an investor in the gaming space, professor at NYU's Stern School of Business.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Joost van Dreunen, an investor in the gaming space, professor at NYU's Stern School of Business. He also recently authored One Up: Creativity, Competition, and the Global Business of Video Games. Our conversation covers the rise and decline of GameStop, what parts of the value chain actually make money in video games.
